summary: Backend regression (pytest) — 22/22 passed. Verified NEW monthly biaya formula: allocation total = biaya + harga_buku (pertemuan is informational, NOT multiplied). Updated TestAllocationTotalFormula::test_total_formula_in_dashboard expected deltas (Paid 150000, Unpaid 250000) and rewrote test_pertemuan_not_multiplied to compare pertemuan=0 vs pertemuan=10 with identical biaya/harga_buku — asserts both deltas ~575000 and rules out old formula (would be 5,750,000 for pertemuan=10). Made both tests race-tolerant against parallel xdist workers. Confirmed server _alloc_total() at server.py:413 returns biaya + harga_buku only.

minor.issue: DAY Literal still includes 'Saturday' (Mon-Fri UI). Sunday=422 but Saturday silently accepted. Carry-over from iter 2/3.
next_invoice_no() fallback branch (unknown student_id) still uses old regex `INV-AELC-{year}-` while active format uses `{MM}`. Dead-inconsistent path. Carry-over.

action_items: (Optional) Remove 'Saturday' from DAY Literal in server.py.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:413 _alloc_total = biaya + harga_buku — matches PRD (monthly biaya). Docstring correctly notes 'pertemuan hanya informasi, tidak dikalikan'.
Dashboard /api/dashboard/stats (pendapatan/outstanding) and /api/dashboard/revenue-monthly both go through _alloc_total (DRY OK).
Same two carry-over minor issues from iterations 2/3 remain unaddressed but non-blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: TestAllocationTotalFormula now enforces the monthly-biaya formula (biaya + harga_buku) via dashboard/stats deltas. test_pertemuan_not_multiplied specifically guards against regression to biaya*pertemuan by verifying pertemuan=10 does NOT multiply the total (delta remains ~575k, not 5.75M). Suite is race-tolerant (uses >= lower-bound + upper-bound assertions) for pytest-xdist. If E1 tweaks the formula again, update expected values in tests around lines 359-395 of backend_test.py.
rca of the issue: User feedback: biaya is monthly rate, not per-meeting. Server _alloc_total already updated from (biaya*pertemuan + harga_buku) to (biaya + harga_buku). Iteration_3 tests still expected the old formula and would have failed. Fixed test expectations and added an explicit anti-regression test that compares pertemuan=0 vs pertemuan=10 to catch any future re-introduction of the multiplier.
